text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Belarus sign an agreement to establish diplomatic ties on the level of embassies.
- French foreign ministry official expresses dissatisfaction over talks between Ankara and Washington on flights over northern Iraq.
- Iraqi oil minister meets Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan in Ankara.
- Iraq prepares trucks to transport food to be imported under the oil-for-food deal signed with the U.N.
- President Saddam Hussein thanks all those who congratulated him on the recovery of his son Uday.
- Editorial on French decision to pull back from the U.S.- led air operations in northern Iraq.
